steps: A real static Scene2D plan produces current-task problems. Severity counts match the complete task; code, source path, property path, raw detail and translated message filters are literal and local. Empty-task and empty-filter states differ. HTML-like authored details stay plain text. No filter/disclosure/language action posts, rebuilds, saves or changes author files.

Two same-task status refreshes preserve the focused search input, backward caret selection, row identity and open details. Selecting a second registered scene leaves the displayed task bound to the original failed job.
Chinese, English and Japanese problems controls remain visible and within a 390px dialog. The original task remains selected independently of the scene picker.

A filtered source action opens the original BOM/CRLF scene and exact actor-speed range, visible after a long soft-wrapped CJK/emoji title. Native editing marks diagnostic context changed; Undo restores all source bytes without pretending the task reran. Existing source search still selects literal matches and preserves Undo/Redo. No author files are saved; only the original static plan exists.
